sharedImplementation.atomicRule: Every observation is classified once as Red, White-only, Blue-only, or Miss within Upper or Lower.
sharedImplementation.derivedRule: Red Total = Red; White Total = Red + White-only; Blue Total = Red + White-only + Blue-only. Derived totals do not duplicate atomic observation custody.
